A malicious actor first studies the target company’s Wi-Fi network, using tools to identify network names (SSIDs), security settings (encryption types, authentication methods), and the types of devices connected. The rogue AP may be left running for an extended period to collect as much data as possible, monitor network traffic, and exploit any further discovered vulnerabilities.
